question: Pralhad Joshi, who inaugurated the India Sugar & Bio Energy Conference held on 26th and 27th September 2024, is currently heading which Union ministry as of October 2024?

options.text: Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution & New and Renewable Energy

solution:
The correct answer is __**Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution & New and Renewable Energy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pralhad Joshi is currently serving as the Union Minister for **Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution & New and Renewable Energy** as of October 2024.
 
• He inaugurated the **India Sugar & Bio Energy Conference** held on 26th and 27th September 2024, showcasing the importance of renewable energy and bioenergy in India's sustainable development goals.
 
• The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution is responsible for **ensuring food security and consumer rights** across India.
 
• This ministry also oversees the **Public Distribution System (PDS)**, which provides subsidized food and essentials to economically weaker sections.
 
• The inclusion of New and Renewable Energy under his portfolio highlights India’s commitment to achieving its **renewable energy targets and transitioning towards sustainable energy sources.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India Sugar & Bio Energy Conference:**

 
 
• A platform to discuss advancements in **sugarcane production, ethanol blending, and bioenergy development.**
 
• Focuses on reducing carbon emissions through the use of biofuels and renewable energy sources.
 
 
 
• **New and Renewable Energy Initiatives:**
 
 
• India aims to achieve **500 GW of renewable energy capacity** by 2030 under its Paris Agreement commitments.
 
• Key projects include the **National Solar Mission** and promotion of wind, hydro, and bioenergy technologies.
 
 
 
• **Public Distribution System (PDS):**
 
 
• An Indian food security system established to distribute essential commodities like rice, wheat, and kerosene to low-income families at subsidized rates.
 
• PDS is critical for alleviating hunger and poverty, especially in rural and economically disadvantaged areas.
 
 
 
• **Ethanol Blending Program:**
 
 
• India has set a target of achieving **20% ethanol blending in petrol by 2025** to reduce its dependence on fossil fuels and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• Sugar mills play a major role in producing ethanol from molasses, contributing to the program's success.
